note: Narration for the product film. Recorded on ElevenLabs as one take (film/voice.mp3); each line is cut from that take (clipFrom-clipTo, seconds) and placed at `at` in the film. start/end are when the line is heard, used for captions. Every claim matches the site's reviewed copy.
voice: Warm, calm, natural American English. Reassuring, not salesy.

lines.text: Got a denial letter from your health insurer?
In about two minutes, you get a free summary in plain English: what happened, what's at stake, and how to appeal.
Then GetMyYes drafts your full appeal packet. You review every page, and you send it yourself.
Free preview. No card. Understand the denial. Build the appeal.
